elements.name: Moon
elements.text: Moon: intuition and reception rather than action, the emotional tides she keeps.

elements.name: Raised hand
elements.text: Raised hand: reaching toward the small moon, receiving rather than reaching to act.

elements.name: Water current
elements.text: Water at her feet: the mutable, emotional element she governs, protection offered from the threshold.
